selection_rule.primary_quality_metric: absolute regret: oracle median score minus chosen median score
selection_rule.missing_regret: null; never replace a failure with an invented penalty
selection_rule.common_set: intersection only after equal completion count; publish identities and denominator
selection_rule.empty_common_set: skip regret criterion and declare inability to compare quality
selection_rule.score: median of seeds 0,1,2 only if all three succeed
selection_rule.oracle: available only when every compatible matrix run succeeds
selection_rule.ties: exact values, no data-dependent tolerance or significance threshold
selection_rule.uncertainty: paired circuit bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20260913; descriptive, not a significance claim
selection_rule.multiple_comparisons: validation selects; no unbiased final quality claim until sealed test
